name: mod-publisher
prompt: The background is pure flat black and completely empty for the entire shot. No room, no floor, no horizon, no objects, no text, no logos, no numbers, no people. Only the glowing element described, isolated on black, as if shot in a blacked-out void. A single clean sheet of pale warm-white paper slides smoothly forward out of a dark slot at the bottom of the frame, then lifts and floats gently upward, tilting slightly, catching a soft warm rim light on its edge. Continuous and steady. Static locked-off camera. Extremely dark, high contrast. The paper is completely blank: no text, no writing, no marks.
